title: Dissociation protocols for cortical scRNA-seq
abstract: We describe a dissociation protocol for mouse cortical tissue.

methods.name: methods
methods.text: Cortical tissue was dissected from adult C57BL/6J mice and minced into 1mm cubes. Tissue was then dissociated as previously described in Okamoto et al. 2016 [ref_1]. Briefly, samples were incubated in dissociation buffer for 30 minutes at 37C with gentle agitation. Single-cell suspensions were filtered through a 40-micron strainer and resuspended in PBS with 0.04% BSA. Cell viability was assessed via trypan blue exclusion; only samples >85% viability were used.
